Hi Sam — following up with the high-level answers while Ben assembles the logs and attestation: 

- Custodianship: Redwood supports both models. By default we manage tenant DEKs in our managed KMS. For customers requiring BYOK, they can bring KEKs which we never persist in plaintext. The SIG response will clarify which model Polaris uses for each tenant.

- Split-key support: We support split-key (threshold-wrapping) for KEK custody in our Private deployments via a split-escrow workflow. Separation-of-duties is enforced via: operator role separation (crypto-operator vs. platform-admin), HSM access tokens, and a documented ceremony with dual signatures. For hosted customers we offer a managed KEK service with dual-control operator approvals for emergency rotations.

- Rotation cadence: KEK (wrapping keys) rotates on a 12–18 month cadence by default; DEKs (data-encrypting keys) rotate on application-triggered schedules (typical: every 90 days for high-sensitivity tenants). Emergency rotations are executed via our incident runbook with automated rewrapping and a post-rotation audit.

Attachments I will deliver: kms_architecture_summary.pdf (diagram + roles), kek_rotation_policy.md (policy excerpt). Ben will attach rotation_log_2027_Q4.csv and an HSM attestation.

If you need the attestation signed by our VP of Security, confirm and we’ll route through DocuSign.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Program Lead, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

Sam — attaching the technical artifacts (see attachments list below). A few concrete notes for your SIG table: 

- HSM vendor: Thales Luna SA HSM clusters (production) + AWS CloudHSM in select regions. We maintain FIPS 140-2 Level 3 attestation for on-prem HSMs and use HSM-backed key wrapping for KEKs.

- Operator separation: HSM operator access requires two-person auth for key import/ceremony events. Key-usage logs (exported) show operator IDs and session nonces; we can redact operator email -> OP_### as requested.

- Rotation log format (sample row): timestamp, key_id, key_type (KEK/DEK), rotation_type (scheduled/emergency), operator_id, ticket_id. Example: 2027-11-03T02:12:08Z, kek-0a1b, KEK, scheduled, OP_042, SEC-1193

Attachments included in secure Drive: kms_architecture_summary.pdf, kek_rotation_policy.md, rotation_log_2027_Q4.csv (redacted), hsm_attestation_signed.pdf. Drive link below requires your security@polarishealth.com email to be whitelisted; if you prefer a signed SFTP drop we can arrange.
